messages.subject: CFA
parts:
Hello dear all
I'm running CFA and SEM but I encountered some message errors.
Any help from your side would be greatly appreciated. I'm using matrix correlation. My covariance matrix is not positive definite and I convert it to positive Covariance matrix definite.
When I run the CFA script I get the following error message:
fit.cfaMod<-cfa(cfaMod,sample.cov=Mal5,sample.nobs=1193, estimator = "ML",std.lv=TRUE)
Error in diag(sample.cov[[g]]) : invalid 'nrow' value (too large or NA)
In addition: Warning message:
In diag(sample.cov[[g]]) : NAs introduced by coercion

This my code( The data is attached):

rm(list = ls())
library(GPArotation)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(lavaan)
library(lavaanPlot)
library(semPlot)
library(semTools)
setwd("~/My topic/My topic/DATA/VALID DATA/Data_final")
Mal<-read.csv("CC_MalariaS.csv",header = TRUE,sep = ",")
str('Mal')
head(Mal)
names(Mal)
attach(Mal)
summary(is.na(Mal))
str(Mal)
#### Convert to numerical#############
Mal$Min_Relative.Humidity<-as.numeric(as.factor(Mal$Min_Relative.Humidity))
Mal$Max_Relative.Humidity<-as.numeric(as.factor(Mal$Max_Relative.Humidity))#######
str(Mal)

####Smooth the data(non positive matrix)###########
d<-cor.smooth(Mal)### Smooth the matrix(non positive)
Mal1<-as.data.frame(d)
#a<-is.na(Mal1)
#summary(a)
Mal2<-solve(Mal1, tol = 1.47364e-11)
## Scale all the variables ####################
Mal3<-apply(Mal2, 2, scale)

####Covert Non positive cov matrix to positive cov matrix#####
U<-svd(Mal3)$u
D<-svd(Mal3)$d
V<-svd(Mal3)$v

###Transform diagonal value  to positive####
D[D<0]<-0

###Definite the positive matrix######
Mal4<-U%*%diag(D)%*%t(V)

###Name le col and row of Mal4###
colnames(Mal4)=c('Mean_Temperature','Min_Temperature','Max_Temperature',
                  'Mean_Relative.Humidity','Min_Relative.Humidity',
                  'Max_Relative.Humidity','Wind.Speed','Rainfall','Malaria_Incidence')
                 
row.names(Mal4)=c('Mean_Temperature','Min_Temperature','Max_Temperature',
                 'Mean_Relative.Humidity','Min_Relative.Humidity',
                 'Max_Relative.Humidity','Wind.Speed','Rainfall','Malaria_Incidence')
colnames(Mal4)
rownames(Mal4)
Mal5<-table(apply(Mal4,1, paste,collapse=""))
Mal5<-as.data.frame("Mal5")
######simple structure###
threefactor<-fa(data.frame(subsetMal1),nfactors =4,rotate ="oblimin",fm="ML",SMC = T,covar = T)
summary(threefactor)
print(threefactor,cut = 0.3,digits = 2)
fa.diagram(threefactor,sort=TRUE, cut=.3, simple=TRUE, errors=FALSE, digits=2, e.size=.05, rsize=0.15)
plot(threefactor)
g<-fa.plot(threefactor, labels=TRUE)

cfaMod<-'F4=~Rainfall+Min_Relative.Humidity
F1=~Max_Temperature+Mean_Relative.Humidity
F2=~Min_Temperature+Mean_Temperature+Max_Temperature
F3=~Wind.Speed
Malaria_Incidence~F1+F2+F3+F4
Rainfall~~Max_Temperature+Mean_Temperature+Min_Relative.Humidity
+Min_Relative.Humidity+Mean_Relative.Humidity
Mean_Temperature~~Mean_Relative.Humidity+Max_Temperature
+Min_Relative.Humidity+Max_Relative.Humidity
Max_Temperature~~Min_Relative.Humidity+Max_Relative.Humidity+
Malaria_Incidence+Mean_Relative.Humidity
Mean_Relative.Humidity~~Malaria_Incidence
Min_Relative.Humidity~~Max_Relative.Humidity
Wind.Speed~~Malaria_Incidence
F1~~F4'
#### Confimratory Factor Analysis##########
fit.cfaMod<-cfa(cfaMod,sample.cov=Mal5,sample.nobs=1193, estimator = "ML",std.lv=TRUE)
summary(fit.cfaMod,fit.measures=TRUE,standardized=TRUE,rsq=TRUE)
